news.text: Nick Lifts #Juve Higher#Woltemade comes on: 4-0 against #VeneziaThe German makes an impact: a goal and an assist to #Koop. Then the third goal by #Cabal and the penalty by #Muani. #Spalletti is sixth.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

TURNING POINT #WOLTEMADEHe comes on and #Juve beats #VeneziaAfter a half of suffering, the thrashing (4-0): the German is decisive and also improves #Kolo. Yet it is not enough for #Spalletti: "More was needed and I want a 1.95m center-forward. I have too many wingers". #Koopmeiners rediscovers the verve of his #Atalanta days: "Yes, now I feel like a leader". #Cabal galloping forward, the #Zhegrova dilemma. Anxiety over #Alajbegović: he will miss the Europa League. [Front Page TuttoSport]

🤩👀 "Bruno #Fernandes remains one to monitor for #Juventus ahead of 2027: he stated that contract renewal talks are currently stalled. The issue is not financial: he wants to win trophies and is evaluating whether the project can still guarantee him that. In the past, he was also linked to #Milan. A situation to follow for these two Italian clubs."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "Goal after reaching 600 matches as a coach in Serie A? With everything that is being said out there, my goal after the 600th match is to make it to the 601st".[@juventusinsidernews]
This media is not supported in your browser VIEW IN TELEGRAM Forwarded from 𝑱-𝑰𝒏𝒔𝒊𝒅𝒆𝒓 | 𝐍𝐞𝐰𝐬 (Cristian) ❤️🗣 Le prime parole di Nick Woltemade dopo aver vinto il premio di MVP.

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "#Zhegrova? He is an incredible footballer, sometimes he does things that not even he can explain how he pulled off. He has brilliance and a wicked foot. When everything seems closed off, he comes up with an invention that is completely unpredictable. However, he also has lapses where he switches off and loses balls that have cost us dangerous counterattacks. He needs to have consistency, that is fundamental because you can't live off just two flashes of brilliance".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "#KoloMuani as a striker? He feels more comfortable out wide, but I need someone who can play as a center-forward with all these matches. On the right I have three wingers, on the left I have another three. I need to succeed in motivating him to play as a striker as well - he can do that too and he has shown it. He needs to be good at creating space for himself to get into these balls. When he receives the ball with a defender on his back, it's not what he likes to do and he made it clear that it's not ideal for him, but it is something we will need to talk about because I need to play him there".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Luciano #Spalletti to 'DAZN': "Differences between the first and second half? They came out in the second half making decisive choices, they were freer in their passing lanes and in looking to play more as a team. In the first half, we lost too many careless balls, with nobody moving. It was crucial that the players recognized something was missing and brought it out onto the pitch".[@juventusinsidernews]
🗣 Randal #KoloMuani to 'DAZN': "The penalty given up by #Woltemade? It was a nice gift from #Woltemade, I'm happy, I thank him".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Randal #KoloMuani to 'DAZN': "Reaction and win? It's never easy when we come back from the international break. We played a great second half, a bit less so in the first half. But we had a great reaction".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Nick #Woltemade to 'DAZN': "Reaction in the second half? Obviously it takes time, maybe we need to be a bit braver, but it is not easy to win every match and do it like we did today by 4-0. It is a response from the team, it takes time. Opponents aren't that easy to beat either, but this second half proves that the team is there and the response has arrived".[@juventusinsidernews]
🚨 Excl, - #Juventus’ young winger Luca #Amaradio (born in 2005) changes agent and joins Michelangelo Sport Management Agency (Arturo Di Napoli). #transfers[Nico Schira]

🗣 Nick #Woltemade to 'DAZN': "Leaving the penalty to #KoloMuani? Actually, it's something normal - in Florence he did me the favor and I returned it. I'm not just a nice guy, I do it for the team".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Teun #Koopmeiners to 'DAZN': "#Woltemade? He's a great guy, in the locker room too. During the international break we ate together... He's good on the pitch, and off the pitch as well".[@juventusinsidernews]

🗣 Teun #Koopmeiners to 'DAZN': "Reaction? In the first half, we misplaced a lot of easy balls, in the second half we did better and when you play better you create more chances, and you could see that with the four goals".[@juventusinsidernews]
🗣 Teun #Koopmeiners to 'DAZN': "Goal? It's a wonderful feeling, I'm happy. Sometimes it's better when you win the ball back because then you have space to attack".[@juventusinsidernews]

👨‍🦲🆙 "#Spalletti is convinced he can hold onto #Juventus: he truly believes in the project, he thinks he can fix the situation and considers himself the right man to build something important by adjusting a few pieces - he has no intention of giving up. The rumors about #Conte annoyed him, but he continues to focus on the pitch and try to get the most out of the team, without letting himself be influenced."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
